behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Multibyte UTF-8 split over fragments with an interleaved ping.
Protocol failure followed by successful fresh message.
docDelivery: Message reassembly, fatal complete UTF-8 validation and BOM preservation.
Ping behavior, snapshot ownership and reset on errors.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Frames {type:text/continuation/ping,fin:boolean,data:Uint8Array including subviews}, finite stream <=1MB total per message. May violate sequencing, ping limit, or final UTF8. UTF8 decoder preserves BOM as U+FEFF. No binary or network I/O.
independence: Integrate byte-fragment reassembly, UTF-8 decoding and interleaved control frames into message consumer.
